dedupe_keys.name: aerial imagery derived dataset of manufactured housing communities in the north central united states

description: Aerial Imagery-Derived Dataset of Manufactured Housing Communities in the North Central United States is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Armin Yeganeh et al. Manufactured housing communities (MHCs) are residential neighborhoods consisting mainly of factory-built homes, providing affordable housing for economically disadvantaged households. There are few, if any, publicly available, systematically created datasets that detail unit-level characteristics of MHCs, e.g., unit location, boundaries, footprint. Coverage: national (US); published in 2025. Formats: Excel, Shapefile, Image, ZIP, Python. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
